properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency of the ethers/web3/ethereumjs toolchain; hash.js@1.1.3 ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations in the build. No direct app call site found — application hashing goes through ethers/web3 utilities — but the declared dependency is part of the shipped crypto surface. Changeable here (remove/upgrade dep) only insofar as the toolchain pins it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 capability shipped in the build's dependency tree: tweetnacl@0.14.5 resolved via bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (OpenSSH-format key KDF, sshpk/http-signature chain in hardhat's older request toolchain), not via ethers. No first-party Ed25519 call site in this repo. Quantum-unsafe signature primitive (Shor); migrate with the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is the secp256k1 ECDSA engine that ultimately signs every transaction this Hardhat project sends (deploys, tests, tasks) via ethers/web3 Wallet/Signer objects. Quantum-unsafe (Shor). No direct elliptic import in app code; usage flows through the toolchain's signing layer. This object records the library capability; the app's live signing-key configuration is reported as a separate finding at hardhat.config.js.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 also exposes ECDH key agreement; declared and shipped in the build. This smart-contract dev repo performs no ECDH of its own — capability present in the shipped library only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 is resolved in yarn.lock (transitive via the web3/ethereumjs stack); its X25519 scalar multiplication is available in the shipped build with no application call site found. Quantum-unsafe key agreement if ever used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 (Node PBKDF2) — dependency of bip39@2.5.0 (BIP-39 mnemonic→seed derivation, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512) and of @ethersproject/pbkdf2 (keystore/brain-wallet derivation in ethers v5). Declared in the lockfile; no first-party PBKDF2 call site in this repo's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 is a direct dependency of ethers@^5.5.2 (devDependency via hardhat/ethereum-waffle); SHA-256 is in its digest set. Shipped with the build; no first-party SHA-256 call site — the repo hashes with keccak256 (SHA-3 family), so SHA-256 is present-but-uncalled capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 capability shipped via the same @noble/hashes@1.1.2 (direct dep of ethers@^5.5.2, devDependency). Presence in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party BLAKE3 call site in this repo. (Note: blakejs@1.1.1 — BLAKE2b — is a separate missed lockfile entry, reported as a finding.)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@2.0.4 resolved in yarn.lock; scrypt KDF is what the dependency stack (web3 accounts, Ethereum keystore files) uses for password-based key encryption. No direct app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 resolved in yarn.lock; ships SHA-3/Keccak (and BLAKE) implementations in the build. No direct app call site — the app's own live keccak256 calls go through ethers/web3, recorded separately as the live SHA-3 asset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 ships XSalsa20-Poly1305 (secretbox/box); post-quantum-safe AEAD, declared and shipped in the build; no application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 via bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (OpenSSH key-format KDF chain); a second resolution, tweetnacl@1.0.3, exists in yarn.lock for a different requester. Provides Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305; no first-party call site found — recorded as shipped capability per the dependency-inventory class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 — dependency of @ethersproject/json-wallets@5.6.1; the memory-hard KDF for Ethereum keystore-file (BIP-3 v3) encryption/decryption in the ethers v5 toolchain. Shipped with the build; the repo itself contains no keystore-handling code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 — SHA-1/SHA-2 family implementation, dependency of create-hash@1.2.0 (browserify crypto polyfill), pulled by bip39@2.5.0 via ganache-core/ethereum-waffle tooling. Shipped in the build; no first-party call site in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic is the secp256k1 library (ECDSA signing + ECDH) at the bottom of the ethers/web3 signing stack for this repo. Same package as ALG-710f61f0/ALG-c9ffc8a8 but this object records the dependency itself; both views are true and complementary.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 — digest library, direct dependency of ethers@^5.5.2 (devDependency via hardhat/ethereum-waffle); backs ethers' hashing utilities (keccak, sha256, hmac, ripemd160, blake2/3...). Shipped with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 — SHA-2/RIPEMD implementations; dependency of @ethersproject/sha2@5.6.1 and of elliptic@6.5.4 (secp256k1, used by @ethersproject/signing-key for wallet signatures). Shipped with the build; no first-party call site. Note: the roster names hash.js@1.1.3, and yarn.lock indeed carries two resolutions — 1.1.3 (line 5057) and 1.1.7 (line 5065, the ethers one).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 resolved in yarn.lock; PBKDF2 is used inside the dependency stack (web3/browserify tooling; keystore and BIP-39 mnemonic password derivation). No direct app call site; ships in the build.
